description: Search the PCC catalog by free text — PCC hosted compression — the engine, the 4 KiB stream pipe, and the meter. Read-only; returns matching entries with name, price, notes, and links. Use to find an entry by keyword; use pcc_get when you already know the entry id.

q.description: Free-text query matched against entry id, name, notes, price, and URL. Omit or send an empty string to list every entry in the catalog.

name: pcc_search
